target_expected_signal.criterion: a session token remains usable across the declared logout, rotation, identity, or scope boundary

expected_signal.criterion: the same transport, identity, parser, browser, callback, or timing channel produces its declared harmless baseline

impact_rules.sensitivity: identify only protected fields or committed actions observed in the fresh response
impact_rules.actor_requirements: score the lowest role and setup that reproduced the unauthorized access

A declared test identity or resource proving the stronger authorization boundary
